visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a white shirt, a dark tie, and a gray suit jacket, stands in a room with warm lighting, looking intense and furrowing his brows; in the background, soft natural light filters through lace curtains. (2) The same man is seen in a medium shot indoors, holding and playing a white plastic recorder while standing near a window; there are various domestic items and cardboard boxes stacked behind him in the background. (3) A wide cinematic shot at twilight shows the dark silhouettes of a tall man and a small child standing on a purple-hued beach, looking at the distant horizon during a deep red and purple sunset. (4) A series of close-up emotional shots follow: a young woman with long black hair shouting with high facial intensity, a middle-aged woman in a floral dress scrubbing clothes in a dimly lit, tiled bathroom, and a man in a white tank top looking down solemnly. (5) In a domestic bedroom setting, a woman in white patterned pajamas sits by a wooden bed talking to a sleeping girl; later, a man with glasses and a green shirt speaks directly forward, and a group of three people eats at a table in a brightly lit room. (6) Three people are seen riding a blue scooter through a city street at night, with one woman leaning her head on the driver's back; the scene then cuts to vertical white text on a black background before showing the final movie title card overlaying the scooter scene.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sequence opens with a conversational male voice over a gentle acoustic guitar strumming at a moderate tempo; the guitar has a bright, clean timbre with minimal reverb. (2) A new audio phase is triggered by the sound of a plastic recorder playing a slightly off-key melody, immediately followed by a female voice shouting with high pitch and sharp vocal edges. (3) A deep-voiced male narrator begins speaking in a calm, professional tone as the background music transitions into a melancholic piano arrangement accompanied by the rhythmic sound of water splashing and fabric scrubbing. (4) The audio becomes dense with overlapping voices in Mandarin and Hokkien, exhibiting high emotional arousal and vocal tension during an argument, while the BGM's harmonic tension increases with added orchestral strings. (5) The sound of a scooter engine idling and birds chirping in the background marks a shift to an outdoor setting, while a melodic male-led pop ballad begins to swell in volume, eventually dominating the audio mix. (6) The final phase consists of the narrator's professional voice-over layered with the pop song's chorus and the mechanical hum of a motorcycle, concluding with a clean fade-out of both speech and music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a movie trailer designed to promote the film 'Family Matters' (我家的事). It uses a montage of emotionally charged scenes—ranging from heated domestic arguments and shouting matches to quiet, sorrowful moments and secrets—to convey the complexity of family relationships, ultimately aiming to pique viewer interest for its September release.
